title: DemoContractsHistory
description: The list of finished runs a runtime can still speak about. This file is a definitions container: validate against history#/$defs/history_entry, never against this root. An entry is a SUMMARY of a run, not the run: the ordered records, the manifest and the referenced frames live in the run's own directory, and this is what a console shows before it opens one.

history_entry.title: HistoryEntry
history_entry.description: One finished run, as the command journal folded it. Every measured field is nullable because the run's completion record is what fills them and an older or a truncated one carries less: a field that was not recorded reads as not recorded, never as zero and never as false. Optional extension: data_mode says whether the run drove hardware, replayed a recording or was synthetic, which the run.started record and the run's manifest have always carried and this list did not, so a reader had to open a run to tell a synthetic pass from a physical one; bundle_digest names the pinned code bundle the run actually ran from. Both are absent from a journal written before they existed, and absent means not recorded: neither may be filled in from the mode the runtime happens to be in now.
